summary: Reel-editor end-to-end validation. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (cloudinary status disabled as expected, project library shape, thumbnail JPEG, /reel valid+invalid aspect, full 9:16+karaoke export producing meta.width=1080/height=1920/karaoke=true, moves length == keep_ranges, caption_events>0, range 206 stream, /export/download attachment, original+karaoke=false export completes with meta.karaoke=false, export before ready => 400, second export while processing => 400, DELETE removes project). Frontend: ReelStudio landing shows all required elements (Upload & Generate heading, dropzone, project-library w/ count=7, cloud-status, aspect pills, cinematic toggle+intensity slider, karaoke toggle, 4 caption style cards). Full upload flow with /app/memory/testvid.mp4 succeeded: generate-progress panel with all 3 steps -> reel-result panel with all stats (Cuts=2, Camera moves=2, Final length 00:11.0, Format 1080×1920), move-timeline chips ('push in','punch in'), reel-preview <video>, Download/Fine-tune/Re-generate/New reel buttons. Editor pane opens on 'Fine-tune in editor', showing editor-aspect-vertical/original, editor-cinematic-toggle, editor-zoom-slider, editor-karaoke-toggle and project-library rail. Library delete confirmed (8->7). Note: export-button test-id is only rendered when export.status != 'done'; after a completed export the LeftRail switches to download-button (data-testid="download-button"), which is expected behaviour, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_projects: has_thumb heuristic returns True when status in ('ready','transcribing') even if thumb.jpg does not yet exist; consumers relying on it strictly may 404 briefly. Consider only reporting True when the file truly exists (lazy-gen already exists in GET /thumbnail endpoint).
_run_export catches all exceptions and stores str(e)[:500] but never logs to server log; a stack trace via logger.exception would greatly aid production debugging of ffmpeg/rendering failures.

ExportBody and ReelSettings define aspect/cinematic/karaoke/... twice; _clean_reel is invoked but Pydantic ge/le validators (e.g. ge=0.2, le=1.6 for zoom_intensity, Literal['9:16','original'] for aspect) would surface FastAPI-native 422s and shrink handler code.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (video playback intentionally black in headless Chromium per H.264 decode limitation)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded testvid.mp4 twice via UI + pytest; created several projects and deleted the throwaway ones. Live library still contains WhatsApp Video real-face asset (untouched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reel-editor features are fully wired. When testing the editor rail after a done export, use [data-testid='download-button'] since [data-testid='export-button'] only exists while export.status != 'done'. Headless Chromium still can't decode H.264 (video preview renders black) — treat only missing elements/errors as failures. Library items render after an async fetch (~500ms) — wait for [data-testid^='library-item-'] before interacting.
